T1_compact_nested_nonempty.statement: Nested nonempty compact admissible lift sets have nonempty intersection in the compact setting.

T2_singleton_closure.statement: If admissible lift sets separate/shrink to one point, the projection seed plus recursive constraints reconstructs a unique identity.

T3_residual_fiber.statement: Closedness alone does not force uniqueness; a nested compact lift tower may retain a non-singleton residual identity fiber.

T4_information_loss_refinement.statement: A single shadow can be lossy while the shadow plus complete compatible lift/refinement data is lossless relative to the chosen identity class.
